sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the material on record.
Having regard to the nature of controversy involved, it is not a fit case for sending to mediation.

2. In the instant case, the short grievance, as projected by the petitioners, is that their land has been taken possession of by the Public Works Department of the Union Territory forcibly and without payment of any compensation.

entities.text: Public Works Department of the Union Territory
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. It is submitted that, pursuant to the intervention made by this Court in a petition filed by a similarly situated persons, the Collector Land Acquisition has initiated the process by issuing notification under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 [" the Act of 2013"] and has intimated to the Chief Engineer, PW (R&B) Department, Chenab Zone, Batote to provide the requisite funds.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: This intimation was sent on 28.02.2024, but the requisite funds have not been placed at the disposal of the Collector Land Acquisition concerned, so as to enable him to proceed further in the matter.

4. The documents on record clearly show that there is some reluctance on the part of indenting Department to respond to the communication of the Collector Land Acquisition dated 20.02.2024 and to provide him the requisite funds.

It is submitted that, pursuant to the intervention made by this Court in a petition filed by a similarly situated persons, the Collector Land Acquisition has initiated the process by issuing notification under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 [" the Act of 2013"] and has intimated to the Chief Engineer, PW (R&B) Department, Chenab Zone, Batote to provide the requisite funds.
opennyai_summary.decision:
This intimation was sent on 28.02.2024, but the requisite funds have not been placed at the disposal of the Collector Land Acquisition concerned, so as to enable him to proceed further in the matter.
This petition is pending since March 2025 and despite opportunities granted, the respondents have failed to file reply.
6.
Be that as it may, on the request of Mr. Ravinder Gupta, learned AAG, four weeks last and final opportunity is granted to file objections indicating the reasons as to why the amount requisitioned by the Collector Land Acquisition has not been provided so far.
The Chief Engineer, PW (R&B)
Department, Chenab Zone, Batote shall also remain present on the next date of hearing to explain his conduct.
